scripts.dev: npm run build -w @atlas/shared && concurrently -n web,api "npm run dev -w @atlas/web" "npm run dev -w @atlas/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @atlas/shared && npm run build -w @atlas/api && npm run build -w @atlas/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @atlas/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: node tests/regression.cjs && node tests/main-folder.cjs && node --test tests/migration-audit.cjs
